description: Delete an in-app placement. Its slots collapse in the app on the next refresh, and in-app steps that target it skip contacts until a placement with the same key exists again. Items already created stay in contact history.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

key.description: Placement key, the id app code passes to the SDK (from list_in_app_placements).

name: delete_in_app_placement

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `delete_in_app_placement` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
